subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime sessions.patch reject every legacy ownerless row, and which branch should establish the canonical ownership helper shared with sessions.create?
rationale: Exact ownership is the safer isolation rule, but it intentionally removes a previously usable legacy path and the permanent helper boundary overlaps another open security PR; those choices require maintainer trust-model and landing-order intent.

options.title: Approve and coordinate landing
options.body: Approve fail-closed ownerless rows, land this proven patch, and require the sessions.create branch to rebase onto one canonical helper.

options.title: Consolidate before either merge
options.body: Move create, patch, and delete ownership checks to one shared helper in this PR before landing either branch.

options.title: Preserve ownerless patch access
options.body: Keep plugin patching of ownerless rows for compatibility, accepting that no authenticated plugin owner can be established for those rows.

recommendation.title: Approve and coordinate landing
recommendation.body: Approve fail-closed ownerless rows, land this proven patch, and require the sessions.create branch to rebase onto one canonical helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is primarily a cross-plugin authorization and trust-model choice, which fits the repository's explicit security-review ownership.
